boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten public Denver library destinations for reading, browsing, and spending time together without admission or a purchase.

cards.subtitle: Denver Public Library — 10 W. Fourteenth Ave. Pkwy.
cards.notes: Bring a book, browse a floor together, or settle into a public reading area. Check the library’s current location hours before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A public-library outing built around browsing and reading.
cards.evidence_claim: Denver Public Library states that its services and spaces are free, and lists Central Library as open to the public.
cards.source_title: A Guide to the Library for Newcomers | Denver Public Library
cards.access_notes: Central Library is a public Denver Public Library location; consult the official locations page for current hours.
